crossRefs.note: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t…
“Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
He cried to Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by…
Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared Yahweh greatly;
for when Jezebel cut off Yahweh’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed…
One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that…
He said, “At this season, when the time comes around, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God…
The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season, when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.
When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.
When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord…
I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does…
May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that…
Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
“Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from…
so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret…
so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret, and your Father, who sees in…
For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according…
Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from…
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection…
For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels…
Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

translations.web: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
translations.bsb: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
translations.kjv: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
translations.asv: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward: and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
